name: Delapparentia
sum: An iguanodont from the Early Cretaceous of Galve, Teruel, Spain, based on a skeleton found in 1958.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: MPT/I.G, found in 1958 by José María Herrero Marzo near Galve, Teruel.
material: The holotype skeleton; later material is discussed in the references.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Ruiz-Omeñaca 2011
